title: Omisión total de notificación formal del acto administrativo de remoción
incident_timestamp_display: 5 de julho de 2024 — Voo LA8159 — Aeroporto SCL (ver Fatos Fixos do Incidente)
allegation_summary: It is alleged that airline staff omitted to provide written notification of the passenger's removal from the flight, as evidenced by transcript statements where staff refuse to deliver any written documentation at the airport, stating that nothing would be provided in writing and directing the passenger to contact customer service. The passenger repeatedly requested written documentation during the disembarkation process, but no formal written resolution was provided at the time of the act. This omission occurred in an environment where the passenger was informed that the company had no solution for cases involving disruptive passengers.
